post.description: Send feedback without credentials, or with an API key to include its organization and mode. Do not include patient information. API-key callers are limited to 10 submissions per hour per key. Anonymous callers are limited to 10 submissions per hour per IP address. A 429 response includes Retry-After in seconds.

get.description: Every medication you can order in the current mode, A to Z by name, then by ID. The list has no search or filters: read every page and choose by name, strength, form and pharmacy. Prices are in cents. `requirements` names the optional prescription fields this pharmacy requires; `compoundingReasons` and `quantities` list the accepted values when the pharmacy limits them, counted in `quantityUnit`. With a `fill`, `price` is per fill and each quantity counts `quantityUnit`, not fills: it is a whole number of fills in units. For a fill of 30 tablets, quantity 60 is two fills. For vials, quantity 1 is one vial and quantity 2 is two vials. A 2 mL vial lists quantities 1–10; its volume is separate from its quantity.

category.description: What the medication is prescribed for. Every strength, form and pharmacy of one medication has the same category.

coldChainRequired.description: Whether the medication requires refrigerated shipping.

compoundingReasons.description: The accepted compounding reasons when the pharmacy limits them.

defaultDirections.description: The catalog's default directions, or null when none are supplied.

form.description: The dosage form, or null when it is unknown.

fullName.description: The name with each ingredient's salt where the catalog records one, such as Enclomiphene Citrate. Equals name otherwise.

quantities.description: The accepted quantities, counted in quantityUnit; an empty list permits any quantity within the request limits.

quantityUnit.description: The unit used to count the prescribed quantity, or null when it is unknown.

requirements.description: The optional prescription field paths that this medication requires.

restrictedStates.description: The states where this medication cannot ship; other states are permitted subject to pharmacy coverage.

shippingOptions.description: The shipping options available for this medication.

shippingSuppliesPrice.description: Each shipping option price includes shippingSuppliesPrice. A mixed order pays the highest supplies price once. Example: $25.00 cold chain + $2.06 supplies = $27.06.

strength.description: The pharmacy's strength text, or null when it is unknown.

variants.description: With expand=variants: every other available strength, form and pharmacy of the same medication, for the current organization and mode.

post.description: One request creates the order, signs it and sends it to the pharmacy. Platforms must send practiceId; practice callers can omit it to use their own practice. With an API key, name the prescriber and send signatureAttestation. Optional prescriber phone and address each default to the practice; no account is looked up by NPI. In the app, the signed-in member signs with the NPI in their settings, or names the prescriber with the same attestation. The patient is found by patient.externalId and updated from the order. Live orders require Live access on the practice and its platform. No payment method is required.
post.summary: Create, sign and submit an order

parameters.name: query

schema.description: Search saved order snapshots: patient names, email, phone and external ID; order external ID; prescriber name and NPI; medication names and brands; pharmacy name. Whole ord_ and pat_ IDs and six-character order numbers also match. Text matches ignore case and allow substrings, word prefixes and similar spellings for alphanumeric words of four or more characters. Every one of the first eight words containing letters or numbers must match; punctuation-only words are ignored. An empty or punctuation-only query leaves the list unfiltered. Date of birth, separate strength fields, practice names, prac_ IDs and rx_ IDs are not searched. Restart pagination when filters change.

get.description: List accessible orders in the current mode, newest first. `externalOrderId` matches exactly, including case. `updatedAfter` accepts an ISO 8601 timestamp with a timezone and returns strictly later updates. Keep filters fixed while paging. `sort` takes `patient` (lowercase firstName + space + lastName A to Z, then order ID) or `created` (oldest first); a leading `-` reverses. Creation time or patient name and the order ID determine cursor order, even when updatedAt changes.

post.description: Affinity POSTs each event as JSON to your registered endpoint URL, with an `Affinity-Signature: t=<Unix time in seconds>,v1=<signature>` header and an `Affinity-Event-Id` header that holds the event `id`. The signature is the lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of `t`, a period (`.`) and the raw request body bytes, keyed with the endpoint's whole signing secret (`whsec_…`). Verify each request before you use it: calculate the signature from the raw body, compare it with `v1` in constant time, and reject the request if they differ or if `t` is more than 300 seconds from your current time. Any 2xx response acknowledges the delivery. After any other status, a redirect or no response, Affinity retries an order event with backoff.
